# Native Disaster: Late Ming Peasant & Little Ice Age Cataclysm (fire_only_once = yes).
oe_mg2_late_ming_uprising = {
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.dds"
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_medium
	fire_only_once = yes

	can_start = {
		oe_mg2_is_host = yes
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		current_year >= 1600
		current_year <= 1680
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mg2_mod_uprising_pacified }
		oe_mg2_late_ming_distress = yes
	}

	can_end = {
		oe_mg2_disaster_pacified = yes
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.008
		global_monthly_food_modifier = -0.18
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.18
		global_monthly_prosperity = -0.006
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.12
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.20
		discipline = -0.05
	}

	on_start = {
		oe_mg2_init_host = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_uprising_active value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_uprising_happened value = 1 }
		oe_mg2_add_uprising = { amt = 30 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_ev_18 } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_ev_18 value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mg2.18
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			6 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			94 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				94 = { }
				2 = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_ev_19 } }
						set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_ev_19 value = 1 }
						trigger_event_silently = oe_mg2.19
					}
				}
				2 = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_ev_20 } }
						set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_ev_20 value = 1 }
						trigger_event_silently = oe_mg2.20
					}
				}
				2 = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_ev_21 } }
						set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_ev_21 value = 1 }
						trigger_event_silently = oe_mg2.21
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_mg2_uprising_active }
			remove_variable = oe_mg2_uprising_active
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_uprising_intensity value = 0 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mg2_mod_uprising_pacified years = 20 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_mg2_ev_22 } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_mg2_ev_22 value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mg2.22
		}
	}
}
